title: TAI post-full-stack bootstrap authority
objective: Allow the fail-closed TAI preflight to accept the exact safe post-full-stack bootstrap state where API/Web already match current main and only TAI service, dedicated environment and dedicated database principal remain to be materialized, while preserving all critical PASS, no-mutation, image, runner and exact-SHA authorities.
boundaries: Exact safe bootstrap has two accepted forms only: the existing four-blocker full-stack bootstrap state, or the post-full-stack three-blocker TAI-only materialization state
The three-blocker state requires API_WEB_EXACT_MAIN=PASS and forbids API_WEB_NOT_EXACT_MAIN
The four-blocker state requires API_WEB_NOT_EXACT_MAIN=BLOCKED and forbids API_WEB_EXACT_MAIN
No additional blocker is accepted in either bootstrap state
All existing critical PASS checks and NO_PRODUCTION_MUTATION_DETECTED remain mandatory
TAI image reference and digest remain exact target-SHA bound
Production self-hosted jobs remain non-root, actionless and without direct Docker authority
Automatic release-chain contract must match the existing wildcard-governed canonical image trigger path
Permanent model admission remains deferred and is never fabricated
Strict zero-blocker postflight still requires API_WEB_EXACT_MAIN and raw passed=true
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
